newsitem.title: USA: Exxon rallies on strong Q1.
newsitem.headline: Exxon rallies on strong Q1.

text.p: Exxon Corp shares rallied 1 to 54-1/2 by 0945 EST after the company reported first quarter net income per share rose to $0.87 from $0.76 a year ago.
"The earnings showed very strong fundamentals, in particular in the upstream," said Salomon Brothers analayst Paul Ting.
Ting noted that Exxon had substantially increased its share buyback program and had enough strength in depth to offset any declines in crude oil price strength.
The company said that from April 1 to April 18 it had repurchased an additional 2.7 million shares after its first quarter repurchase of 5.3 million shares.

"Exxon is very well diversified downstream and there were strong volumes in chemicals although there are some worries on oversupply, while its refining numbers were strong, primarily on their Far East operations," Ting said. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
